title: Count of smaller numbers after self
statementMd:
For each index return how many elements to its right are strictly smaller.

**Example:** `count_smaller([5, 2, 6, 1])` returns `[2, 1, 1, 0]`.
hints: Insert from the right into a sorted list with bisect.
solutionMd:
```python
def count_smaller(nums):
    import bisect
    seen, out = [], []
    for x in reversed(nums):
        i = bisect.bisect_left(seen, x)
        out.append(i)
        seen.insert(i, x)
    return out[::-1]
```

The insertion point counts smaller elements.

def count_smaller(nums):
    import bisect
    seen, out = [], []
    for x in reversed(nums):
        i = bisect.bisect_left(seen, x)
